listLede: Draft and publish brochure pages. The public site reads this list when Pages is on.
editLede: Title, body, and SEO follow the locale files. The slug is shared. Save draft keeps it off the public site. Publish shows it at /locale/slug.
slugHint: Shared across locales. about → /locale/about. home → /locale (site root).
tagsHint: Comma-separated. Stored on this pack’s page tags, not media tags.
metaTitleHint: Browser tab and search title. Falls back to the page title when empty.
metaDescriptionHint: Short summary for search results and link previews.
ogHint: Starforge media id. Shared across locales.
tagsLede: Tags on this pack. Add one here, or type comma-separated names on a page.
tagConfirmDelete: Delete this tag? Pages keep their other tags.
versionsHint: Last 20 saves. Restore replaces the current page and keeps that current copy in this list.
versionConfirm: Restore this version? The current page is saved first.
versionEmpty: No saved versions yet. The next save starts the list.
